candidates.change_summary: Replace the assignment to acc.unlockTime so it always sets to the provided _unlockTime (removing the max with block.timestamp), causing unlockTime to potentially be in the past.
Replace the assignment to acc.unlockTime so it always sets to block.timestamp (ignoring provided _unlockTime), making every deposit set unlockTime to now.
Replace the increment of acc.balance to set acc.balance = msg.value (dropping previous balance), changing resulting balance after Put.
Insert a requirement that msg.value is at least MinSum, causing Put to revert for smaller deposits and thus change observed state after Put.
Replace the call to LogFile.AddMessage with no logging (delete that statement), altering externally observable history recorded by Log contract.
Replace the strict '>' unlockTime check with '>=' so collect is allowed when block.timestamp equals unlockTime.
Remove the MinSum guard from the if condition so collects below MinSum are allowed.
Change the order to subtract balance after the external call (introducing a reentrancy-exposed behavior change).
Change the external transfer from call to send (returns a bool but sends 2300 gas), altering success semantics and potential observable outcomes.
Remove the revert on failed external call so failed sends do not revert state (changing observable Collect outcome).
